en: A colorized vintage view over a European city with a river running through the middle, crossed by several metal bridges. Historic multi‑story buildings with red and yellow facades line both banks. On the right, a wooded hill rises above the city, topped with fortification‑like buildings and a clock tower, labeled "Schlossberg". At the top left of the image the word "Graz" appears, indicating the scene is of the city of Graz and its Schlossberg hill.
